name: Analakely market and the Zoma
subtitle: Analakely is a central district whose market took over from the Zoma, a large open-air weekly market in the heart of the city.

facts.label: Origin of the Zoma
facts.value: Created by a powerful king at the end of the 18th century.

facts.label: Setting
facts.value: A big open-air market at the heart of the city.

facts.label: Removal
facts.value: The city authorities removed it at the end of the 1990s with no protest.

facts.label: Return
facts.value: The Zoma, once weekly, now returns as daily or seasonal events at Analakely.

parts.text: Analakely is a central district whose market took over from the Zoma, a large open-air weekly market in the heart of the city. The Zoma was removed at the end of the 1990s and has returned in event form.
